records.title: Oak National Academy — Combine multiplication with addition and subtraction
records.read: Actual HTML key points, misconception and teacher tip: brackets/grouping, priority and equal-priority pairs; licence section inspected. No video/slides claimed.
records.adopted: Contrast same numerals with/without brackets and highlight a complete part; teach equal-priority pairs explicitly.
records.rejected: No BODMAS ranking that implies multiply before divide or addition before subtraction; no speed criterion, copied diagrams or child-efficacy claim.
records.licence: Page states © Oak National Academy2025 OGL3 except stated exceptions. Original Finnish lesson and art; source materials not redistributed.
records.usage: Primary comparison; original new numerical examples, wording, code and mathematical diagrams.
records.limits: No Finnish curriculum mandate inferred from comparator, no efficacy or human/learner validation claim.

inventory.objective: Interpret a multiple-operation expression, with item-dependent operation prerequisites.
inventory.hints: Identify multiplication, grouped bracket part; provide operation-specific wrong-value explanations and transferred repeated per-person total.
media: writtenanim.ts138–211 exprScene: finite row reductions, actual precedence; timing is illustrative, not physics
inventory.audit: LESSON_AUDIT.md112 and653–655: notebook/steps, missing whyAt/hints and prior overflow fixed in Lite; reported historical browser checks are not our evidence.
inventory.coverageDifference: COVERAGE113/301,878–881 omit steps and still list2demos; actual NodeSpec has3.
inventory.extends: Default+/- only route; original group drawings before general rule, controllable one-part reduction, optional full visited rows. Short part-construction task accepts both independent complete parts of the complex expression. Numeric answers remain direct.
inventory.corrected: Do not require multiplication/division globally. Do not treat one canonical displayed route as all valid reasoning. Every shown = must compare same-valued full expressions.
inventory.limits: Whole arithmetic with exact nonzero division in authored scope; no powers, variables or arbitrary algebra-equivalence engine. Short answers do not prove independent full procedure.

alignment.authority: Actual executable NodeSpec+families/media/audit read; Lite is existing unapproved comparator, not efficacy or production proof.
